evals.prompt: EN: Plan a linked English reading deck on retrieval memory. You may examine at most 8 metadata records in 2 queries or 10 minutes, and read at most 2 full texts. I have not approved any discovered full text. Show candidate decisions, then ask for exact targets before reading them. Do not recursively follow citations. ZH: 规划检索记忆互链英文阅读演示；最多8条元数据、2次查询或10分钟、2篇全文。尚未批准新发现全文；展示候选决策后具名请求授权，不能递归追引。
evals.expected_output: Bilingual-capable scoped plan and draft v1 bundle; exact finite counters/stop conditions, include/defer/exclude ledger, versioned named approval checkpoint; no unapproved full-text access. Identifies analyst→cross-link→writer artifacts and no builder research.

evals.prompt: EN: Draft a handoff plan for two supplied, already approved PDFs A v2 and B v1, with publisher version URLs in their metadata. Work offline in Chinese, metadata cap 0/full-text cap 2. A appendix pp. 11–12 are unreadable. The writer skill is missing. Do not execute teaching code. Preserve the analyst full-reading standard and explain exact project.zh-CN.json coverage, evidence/navigation and delivery status without fabricating paper content. ZH: 两篇已批PDF离线中文交接，元数据0/全文2，A附录11–12页不可读、writer缺失；不运行代码，不编论文内容，保留全文标准及真实覆盖和待呈现状态。
evals.expected_output: No repeated target approval or online calls. A remains partial with unread pp.11–12; B requires actual all-page inspection before full-text. Reports/claims/typed relations/stable slides in one v1 bundle; original-source writer guidance before handoff; not-run code and no fabricated outputs; pending presentation, not completed deep read/HTML.
